quotes: Priority Mail® service includes tracking and delivery in 2-3 days

In most cases, the expected delivery date printed on your receipt or provided at checkout will reflect a delivery time of 2-3 days and is based on origin, destination, and drop-off time. The expected delivery date does not come with a money-back guarantee.
Prices start at $11.50 at a Post Office.
Ground Advantage packages are delivered in 2-5 days and USPS Tracking® service is included in the price.
Prices start at $8.40 at a Post Office™ location.
Packages going to certain places (including Alaska, Hawaii, and offshore destinations), or containing hazardous materials may receive slower service.

Priority Mail Express® service provides 1–3 day delivery service by 6 PM with a money–back guarantee. You get competitive prices and fast delivery every day, all year, with limited exceptions, to most U.S. addresses and PO Boxes™.
Prices start at $37.05 at a Post Office.
With FedEx 2 day shipping, your packages are delivered within 2 business days throughout the United States.
Choose economical FedEx 2Day® shipping and get your package there by the end of the second business day. Packages will arrive by 5:00 p.m. to most areas and by 8 p.m. to residences.
With FedEx 2Day A.M., you get delivery in 2 business days by 10:30 a.m. to U.S. businesses and by noon to most residences.
The latest you can drop off a package at a FedEx location for 2 day shipping varies by location. Call to confirm cutoff times with the store.
source_extracts.table_notes: Delivery days Monday–Friday (Saturday in certain areas for an additional charge); packages up to 150 lbs, up to 119" length.

quotes: UPS 2nd Day Air offers reliable 2-day shipping for packages that can arrive anytime on the second business day.
Get your shipment delivered in two business days with morning delivery available to eligible destinations.
UPS 2nd Day Air delivers to all 50 states and Puerto Rico with some limitations in Alaska and Hawaii.
Available for packages up to 150 lbs. and 108” long.
Saturday delivery is available.
cost-effective, reliable ground shipping within one to five business days
UPS, FedEx and other private carriers cannot deliver to a USPS PO Box — reused from CONFIRMED.md per gate rule
Effective Feb. 12, 2026, the FedEx Money-Back Guarantee applies to the following Fedex services for U.S. payors: ... FedEx 2Day® A.M. ...
In order to balance our focus on service and safety, the money-back guarantee for all other FedEx® services will remain suspended until further notice.
The UPS® Service Guarantee is currently active for the below Air and International services: Domestic ... UPS 2nd Day Air A.M.®
The UPS Service Guarantee remains suspended for all other UPS® shipments and services not specified in the above sections, from any origin to any destination.

Effective Nov. 21, 2026 — To accommodate the expected seasonal volume, A.M. delivery commitment times of 12 p.m. or earlier will be extended 90 minutes from Nov. 21, 2026-Jan. 4, 2027, for the following time-definite FedEx services: U.S. Domestic ... FedEx 2Day® A.M. ...
Note: Printed labels may not reflect the extended time.
